name: Bizantine Labs
description: Bizantine Labs is an institutional, non-custodial DeFi vault curator and risk infrastructure provider. Active in digital assets since 2017, the team designs, deploys, and continuously monitors multi-chain vault strategies across Ethereum, Base, Flare, Monad, and other emerging ecosystems, spanning restaking, overcollateralized lending, real-world asset yield, and structured onchain strategies.
